-- SELECT type, name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE tbl_name IN ('pitr_state', 'item_history') ORDER BY type, name
index	idx_item_history_key	item_history	CREATE INDEX idx_item_history_key ON item_history (table_id, pk, sk, seq)
index	idx_item_history_table_seq	item_history	CREATE INDEX idx_item_history_table_seq ON item_history (table_id, seq)
index	sqlite_autoindex_pitr_state_1	pitr_state	NULL
table	item_history	item_history	CREATE TABLE item_history (
    seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    table_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tables(table_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    pk TEXT NOT NULL,
    sk,
    commit_time_us INTEGER NOT NULL,
    item_data TEXT
)
table	pitr_state	pitr_state	CREATE TABLE pitr_state (
    table_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tables(table_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    recovery_period_days INTEGER NOT NULL,
    enabled_at_us INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pruned_to_us INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    pinned_at_us INTEGER,
    pin_expires_us INTEGER
)
